name: 克林顿·戴维森
bio_short: 美国物理学家, 1937年诺贝尔物理学奖得主. 他通过著名的"戴维森-革末实验" (`davisson_germer_1927`), 首次观察到电子衍射现象, 证实了物质波的存在.
bio_short_en: An American physicist and 1937 Nobel laureate. He confirmed the existence of matter waves by observing electron diffraction in the famous 'Davisson-Germer experiment' (`davisson_germer_1927`).
